title: Inner proof index
statement: For a Boolean circuit $C$, let $V$ be its quadratic variable count and let $P=V+2^V+2^{V^2}$ be its quadratic proof length. Each index $i$ among the $2^V+2^{V^2}$ inner-proof positions is sent to position $V+i$ in the full proof.
hypotheses_covered: An index among the $2^V+2^{V^2}$ inner-proof positions
